question: Former Union Minister _______ from Manipur was awarded Padma Shri in 2023 by the Union government for his contribution in public affairs in the last four decades.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thounaojam Chaoba**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Thounaojam Chaoba** from **Manipur **was awarded **Padma Shri **in **2023 **by the Union government.
 
• He was recognized for his significant contributions in public affairs over the last four decades.
 
• Thounaojam
